concept.title: Patients and health professionals
concept.shortdesc: Patients and residents using NHS and social care services, including those wanting to complain, and the clinicians and staff who deliver or refer to them.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People eligible for a service because they are patients of a local GP surgery or health service, or live in a particular health area.
: People who want to raise a complaint or concern about NHS or social care services, or need help doing so.
: Clinicians, NHS staff and other health and social care workers who use or refer to a service.
